args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) following the v2.3.1 deploy, with a ~18% error rate. Mitigation: rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. The first rollback attempt partially failed (only us-east updated due to an orchestrator error); a retry completed the rollout to all regions. Service is now healthy with an error rate of ~0.2%. Follow-up: investigate root cause of v2.3.1 failure and the orchestrator error during rollback before attempting to redeploy v2.3.1.

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what happened:

**Issue:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.

**Mitigation:**
- Identified **v2.3.0** as the most recent release that was healthy in production.
- Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all regions. The first rollback attempt partially failed (only us-east updated due to an orchestrator error), so I retried and the rollout completed across all three regions.
- Verified the service is now **healthy** with an error rate of ~0.2%.

**Incident:** Opened SEV2 incident **INC-0001** — "checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0" — documenting the failure, the rollback, the partial-failure/retry, and follow-up actions (root-cause v2.3.1 and investigate the orchestrator error before redeploying). The incident creation call reported a timeout, but I confirmed the incident was successfully created and is open, with the on-call engineer paged.

transcript.reasoning_content: Check deployment history to find most recent healthy release.

transcript.content: All regions are now on v2.3.0 and healthy (error rate down to 0.2%). Opening the SEV2 incident:
transcript.reasoning_content: Rollback succeeded, healthy now. Open SEV2 incident.
